description: A four-pole ladder filter whose response is set by a five-channel signal at the FILTER TOPOLOGY jack: a dry level and a level for each pole, mixed to make any filter shape

params.text: Sets the cutoff over ten octaves with C4 at 261.63Hz in the middle, one octave to a turn of the dial, held between 1Hz and 18% of the sample rate
Sets the resonance, 0 to 1 on the dial; the figure is squared and multiplied by ten inside, so self-oscillation comes only near the top
Scales the voltage at the cutoff CV jack, -1 to +1, before it is added to the cutoff in octaves
Scales the voltage at the resonance CV jack, -1 to +1, before a tenth of it is added to the resonance

inputs.text: Shifts the cutoff at one octave per volt, scaled by the trimpot above it
Shifts the resonance, 10V covering the whole of the dial's travel through the trimpot above it; the total is held between 0 and 1
The signal to be filtered, with ±5V taken as full scale
A five-channel signal setting the filter response: the first channel is the dry level and the next four are the level of each pole; with nothing patched the filter is a four-pole lowpass

outputs.text: The filtered signal at ±5V, soft-clipped on the way out

notes: with nothing patched to FILTER TOPOLOGY this is a plain four-pole lowpass; a Personality module on that jack is what makes it anything else
the topology signal is read every sample, so crossfaders, switches and slew limiters can morph the filter shape on the way in
0.3125V on a topology channel is unity for that pole, since the mix is divided by ten thirty-seconds before it is clipped
the number of channels at the audio input sets the channel count of the output
menu: Add Morphscope (right side) — places a Morphscope expander immediately to the right of this module

inputs.0:
1V per octave · continuous · polyphonic

unpatched it reads 0V.
inputs.1:
0 to 10V · continuous · polyphonic

unpatched it reads 0V; the knob and this input are summed and the total held to 0 to 10V.
inputs.3:
±10V · continuous · polyphonic

unpatched it reads a four-pole lowpass.
